classification: Independent acceptance of the full original compact BlockGrowthBound supplier under unchanged place, tower, top-lift and InDDplus2 hypotheses
accepted_mathematical_interfaces: The common free GL_s block is obtained from the original PhiFun and fixed-head Schur coordinates. A determinant cutoff bounds Z inverse; the previously proved exact inverse radical formulas give one jointly compact support and positive Gram cutoff, not just compactness of individual slices. Original word operators are applied before the cutoff and all rational/spectral corrections are retained.

The actual residue pairing has the finite C^m continuity needed to pass the compact matrix stationary-phase germ through its Hilbert quotient. Recovered section94 proposition jp-reg-bound supplies the underlying C^4 weighted bound; fixed old finite-order operators only increase m. The coefficient-to-Gram-vector map below the terminal level is antilinear, reversing the character exactly.

Original point weights match CutGermLowGermW and CutGermTopB. The quotient-dimension difference n=s-1 and dmu_betaU=pi^-1 dz give the exact lower pi^-n and terminal pi^n factors. No Haar or type factor is suppressed.

Terminal finite types retain the exact coefficients c_W/S_w and the original Theta compact representatives. The actual wPt density contributes (1-TTprime/abs(x^n D)^2)^((k-1-length(w))/2), with error O(abs(x)^(-2n)) on compact nonzero D. The original positive Gram cutoff handles its potentially negative exponent at bounded x.

The root-packet change of variables has Jacobian s^2*abs(z)^(2s-2). Compact-annulus stationary phase and Riemann-Lebesgue, followed by monotone exhaustion, prove global L2 integrability of B without assuming a globally small remainder. Uniform L2 bounds and the tails of B justify both mixed packet limits.
The branch q_x=(x/(x+delta))^((s-1)/s) tends to one over the full complex infinity filter and gives s*((x+delta)*q_x-x) tending to delta. Thus no angular restriction is introduced.

A translation-invariant mean on the actual dual lattice retains a positive-definite residual Gram function. Both eta signs give exactly the prescribed reciprocal pair (t,(t^-1+sigma)^-1), and the lattice limsup is bounded by the original full punctured complex limsup.

Probability Haar Fourier coefficients of covol(Lambda)/pi times the periodization are pi^-1 times the original Fourier integral. Fejer positive-definite sums are nonnegative, and lower semicontinuity gives the pointwise bound at every translate, including those containing zero. No pointwise Poisson convergence is assumed.

All admissible old words, bounded-extension hypotheses, original positive normalizers and arbitrary rank-two lattices are retained. Only the w extension itself is needed to obtain the uniform L2 bound; this does not weaken the stated original contract.
